sections.title: Keep a copy of the life that's happening
paragraphs: I'm adnaan, welcome to my blog. This is where I keep the articles I've written, stray thoughts, projects in progress, and the everyday moments worth keeping.

I want to record the process of making: how an idea starts, how a problem gets taken apart, which detours didn't work, and which moments make me want to keep going. Looking back later, these records will show how I got here, little by little.

sections.title: Making things, and meeting myself along the way
paragraphs: Code is one way I express ideas. Turning a vague thought into something you can touch, and slowly polishing a small detail until it feels right — the process itself is worth recording.
I also want room for life beyond code. A photo, a piece of music, a question I haven't figured out yet — all of it can live here. Together with the code, they make a more complete me.

sections.title: Set the past in order, then turn the page
paragraphs: This blog takes its theme from JJ Lin's “Turn of the Page”. To me it's about time, making peace with yourself, and still being willing to start again after a journey ends.

I hope this “copy” keeps what deserves to be kept, and reminds me: the road already walked is part of me now — no need to stay stuck on the same page. Slower is fine, pausing is fine, but I can always keep writing.

sections.title: From my writing, to our meeting
paragraphs: The thoughts here may be unfinished. I'm happy to open them up and hear different experiences and answers. One conversation might give a question I faced alone a brand-new way out.
If a passage or a small project happens to touch your life a little, you're welcome to leave an echo. Thank you for stopping by, and for being part of this still-growing story.
